m: अभि-√ 1. गा -जिगाति (impf. -अजिगात्; aor. Subj. -गात्) to go near to, to approach, arrive at, RV. &c.; to get, gain.
a: अभिगा — = अभी q. v.

m: अभि-√ गाह् Ā. (p. -गाहमान) to penetrate into (acc.), RV. x, 103, 7.

v: aBigAmin
tri॰ aBigacCati aBi + gama--Rini aBigantari । “ftukAlABigAmI syAt svadAranirataH sadA” manuH । “rAjapatnyaBigAmI ca dagDavyAste kawAgninA” yA॰
m: अभि-गामिन् mfn. having sexual intercourse with (in comp.), Mn. iii, 45; Yājñ. ii, 282, &c.
a: अभिगामिन् — a. Approaching, having intercourse with; Ms. 3. 45; Y. 2. 282.
अभिगामुक — a. Inviting, leading one to approach (as qualities).

m: अभि-√ गै (Imper. 2. sg. -गाय, or -गाय, 2. pl. -गायत) to call or sing to (acc.), RV.; to enchant, AitBr.; to sing (a hymn, &c.), ŚBr. &c.; to fill with song, R.; to celebrate in song, R.
a: अभिगै — {c1c} P. 1 To call to, sing to. --2 To fill with song, make noisy with songs; भृंगराजाभिगीतानि (वनानि) Rām. --3 To sing, celebrate in song; तदप्येष श्लोकोऽभिगीतः Ait. Br. --4 To approve, allow.

m: अभि-√ 1. गॄ -गृणाति, to call to or address with approbation; to join in (acc.); to welcome, praise; to approve of, accept propitiously, allow.
a: अभिगॄ — {c9c} U. Ved. 1 To call to or address approvingly, join in, welcome, praise. --2 To accept propitiously, allow, approve.

v: aBigIta
tri॰ AnukUlyena gItaH । 1 AnukUlyArTaM stute 2 aBitogIte ca ।
m: अभि-गीत mfn. addressed or praised in song, RV. ix, 96, 23.
अभि-गीत n. a song, Divyāv.
a: अभिगीत — p. p. Sung, chanted, celebrated in song &c.

m: अभि-गूर्त mfn. approved of RV. i, 162, 15; TS.
a: अभिगूर्त — p. p. Approved of; destined for an offering; uttered (with praise).

m: अभि-गूर्ति f. song of praise, RV. i, 162, 6 and 12.
a: अभिगूर्तिः — f. 1 Song of praise; constant desire or thought; Rv. 1. 162. 6. --2 Effort, exertion.

v: aBigUrtta(rRRa)
tri॰ aBi + gura--kta vede natvABAvaH । 1 ukte “izwaM vItamaBigUrttam” yaju॰ 25, 37, “aBigUrttaM ye yajAsahe ityaBigUrttyoktam” ve॰ dI॰ loke tu aBigUrRREtyeva aByudyate tri॰ ।
aBigUrtti

strI aBi + sAtatye gura--ktin । satatasaNkalpe “tezAmaBigUrttirna invatu” f॰ 1, 162, 6 । “aBigUrttiH saNkalpaH sarvvaTA karaRIyamiti budDiH” BA॰ 2 aBita udyame ca “utotezAmaBigUrttirna invatu” f॰ 1, 162, 12, “aBigUrttiH” udyamaH BA॰ ।

m: अभि-गूर्या (Ved.) ind.p. having approved of RV. ii, 37, 3.

a: अभिगंतृ — a. One who approaches or has intercourse (with a woman); one who understands &c.

m: अभि-गच्छत् mfn. approaching, &c.

अभि-√ गम् -गच्छति, to go near to, approach (with acc.); to follow, Kāṭh.; R.; to meet with, find; to cohabit (said of men and women), Yājñ. ii, 205, &c.; to undertake; to get, gain, obtain, AV.; ŚBr. &c.; (with मनसा, or मेधया or हृदयेन) to understand, RV. iii, 60, 1; TS.; ŚBr. : Caus. -गमयति, to study, MBh. i, 1295.
a: अभिगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go to, go near to, approach (with acc.); एनमभिजग्मुर्महर्षयः R. 15. 59; Ki. 10. 21; मनुमेकाग्रमासीनमभिगम्य महर्षयः Ms. 1. 1; 11. 100. --2 To follow, go after; अनुरागाद्वने रामं दिष्ट्या त्वमभिगच्छसि Rām. --3 To find, meet with (casually or by chance). --4 To cohabit, have sexual intercourse (with man or woman); अभिगंतास्मि भगिनीं मातरं वा तवेति ह Y. 2. 205; अभ्यगच्छः पतिं यत्त्वं भजमानं Mb. --5 To take to, undertake, betake oneself to. --6 To get, to share in; be subject to; निद्रामभिगतः Rām. --7 To conceive, apprehend, understand, comprehend. --Caus. 1 To cause to go to or approach; take, convey, send; Dk. 102. --2 To cause to apprehend; explain, teach.

v: aBigama

pu॰ aBi + ABimuKye AnukUlyevA gama--GaY । ABi muKyena gamane “tavArhato nABigamena tfptam” raGuH AnukUlyena 2 gamane “svarucyA kriyamARe tu yatrAvaSyakriyA kvacit । nodyate niyamaH so'tra ftAvaBigamo yaTeti” mImAMsA । BAve lyuwa । aBigamanaM tatrEva na॰ । “jyezWABigamanAt pUrvvaM tenApyanaBinanditA” raGuH । “pApakfnmucyate pApAttIrTABigamanena ca” smftiH ।
m: अभि-गम m. (g. अनुशतिकादि, q.v.), approaching
visiting, Megh.; Ragh. v, 11
sexual intercourse, Yājñ. ii, 291.
a: अभिगमः, --गमनं — 1 (a) Approaching, going or coming to, visit, arrival; तवार्हतो नाभिगमेन तृप्तं R. 5. 11, 17. 72; ज्येष्ठाभिगमनात्पूर्वं तेनाप्यनभिनंदिता 12. 35, K. 158; Pt. 3. (b) Finding out; enjoying; कृत्वा तासामभिगममपां Me. 49 (सेवनं Malli.). --2 Sexual intercourse (with a man or woman); परदारभिगमनं K. 107; प्रसह्य दास्यभिगमे Y. 2. 291; Pt. 1; H. 1. 104; नीच˚ Y. 3. 298, 2. 294.

m: अभि-गमन n. = अभि-गम
the act of cleansing and smearing with cow-dung the way leading to the image of the deity (one of the five parts of the उपासन with the Rāmānujas), Sarvad.

v: aBigamya

tri॰ aBigantuM Sakyate sOmyAkAratvAt । ABimuKyena gantuM Sakye “adyapraBfti BUtAnAmaBigamyo'smi SudDaye” kumA॰ । “so'BigamyaSca pUjyaSca karttavyaSca pradakziRam rAmA॰ । “aDfzyaScABigamyaSca yAdoratnErivArRavaH” raGuH । aBi + gama--lyap । ABimuKyena gatvetyarTe avya॰ “manumekAgramAsInamaBigamya maharzayaH” iti manuH ।
m: 1. अभि-गम्य mfn. to be visited, Kum. vi, 56, &c.
accessible, tempting (for a visit), Ragh. i, 16.
2. अभि-गम्य ind.p. having approached.
a: अभिगम्य — pot. p. 1 To be approached, visited or sought; Ku. 6. 56. --2 Accessible, that can be approached without fear, inviting; तथाप्यनभिगमनीयो लोकस्य Mk. 4; भीमकांतैर्नृपगुणैः … अधृष्यश्चाभिगम्यश्च R. 1. 16.

v: aBigantavya
tri॰ aBi + gama--tavya । aBigamye sevye ca “santaH sadABigantavyA yadi vopadiSanti te” vaSi॰ ।
aBigantf
tri॰ aBi + gama--tfc striyAM NIp । yudDArTam ABimuKyena 1 gantari 2 AnukUlyena gantari ca । “kzatraM varuRo'BigantEba brahma” Sata॰ bA॰ ।
m: अभि-गन्तृ m. one who understands, ŚBr.
‘one who pursues’, insidious, Kāṭh.
one who has intercourse with a woman.

v: aBigara
pu॰ aBi + gF--stutO ap । 1 aBitaH stave । “anuzwup te'Bigaram” iti yaju॰ 8, 47 ।
m: अभि-गर See अभि- √ 1. ग्री below.
अभि-गर m. a calling out in approbation (part of the sacrificial ceremony), VS.; KātyŚr.
the priest who calls out approvingly (to the other priests), MaitrS.; Lāṭy. (cf. अपगर.)
a: अभिगरः — [गॄ-अप्] Song of praise; praise.

m: अभि-√ गर्ज् to roar at, bawl at, raise savage or ferocious cries, MBh. &c.
a: अभिगर्ज् — {c1c} P. To roar or bawl at, to raise wild or ferocious cries.

m: अभि-गर्जन n. ferocious roaring, uproar, R.
a: अभिगर्जनं, अभिगर्जितं — A wild, savage or ferocious roar; up-roar.

m: अभि-गर्जित n. a savage cry, uproar, R.

v: aBigata
tri॰ aBi + gama--kta । 1 AnukUlyena prApte 2 sevite 3 ABimuKyena gate ca ।
m: अभि-गत mfn. approached, &c.

v: aBigezRa
tri॰ aBi + gE--izRa । aBito gAyake “yadelavA aBigezRAScaranti” SrutiH ।
m: अभि-गेष्ण mfn. calling to, AitBr.
a: अभिगेष्ण --ष्णु — a. [गै-इष्णुच्] Singing.

m: अभि-गृध्न mfn. See मिथ्याभि-गृध्न.
अभि-गृहीत mfn. taken hold of, &c.

v: aBigfhItapARi
tri॰ AnukUlyArTaM gfhItaH pARiryena । AnukUlyArTaM kftAYjalO ।
m: अभि-गृहीत—पाणि mfn. having the hands joined, BhP.
अभि-गोपाय Nom. P. ˚यति, to guard, protect, ŚBr.

v: aBigoptf
tri॰ aBito gopAyati aBi + gupa--tfc striyAM NIp । aBirakzake ।
m: अभि-गोप्तृ mfn. guarding, protecting, ŚBr.
a: अभिगोप्तृ — m. Protector, guardian.

m: अभि-ग्राहिन् mfn. seizing, Hir.

अभि-√ ग्रह् -गृह्णाति, to take hold of, take up (from the soil), TS. &c.; to accept, receive, MBh.; to set (as a blossom), BhP.; to lay together, to fold (the hands) See अभिगृहीत-पाणि below: Caus. -ग्राहयति, to catch, surprise, e.g. रूपाभिग्राहित, taken in the very act, Daś.
a: अभिग्रह् — (Ved. ग्रभ्) {c9c} U. 1 To take or seize, catch, catch hold of, seize forcibly, attack; रिपुणाभिगृह्य Dk. 5, 98, 103. --2 To accept, take. --3 To receive, (as a guest). --4 To fold, lay or bring together (as the hands). --5 To set, show or bring forth (as blossom, fruit &c.). --Caus. To catch or surprise one in the very act, to let oneself be so caught; अर्यवर्यस्य कस्यचिद् गृहे चोरयित्वा रूपाभिग्रहितो बद्धः Dk. 96.

m: अभि-ग्रहीतृ mfn. one who seizes, MaitrS.

s: puM, (aBi + grah + BAve ap .) aBiyogaH । ityamaraH ॥ kalahAhvAnaM । apacikIrzayA atikramyAkramaRaM । ABimuKyena yudDAdipravfttiH । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥ gOravaM । aBigrahaRaM । iti medinI ॥ luw iti BAzA । (cOryyakaraRaM .)

m: अभि-ग्रह m. seizing taking hold of
attack, onset, L.
defiance, challenge, L.
robbing, plundering, L.
authority, L.
a vow, Jain.
a: अभिग्रहः — 1 Seizing, robbing, plundering. --2 Attack, assault, onset. --3 Challenge. --4 Complaint. --5 Authority, power, weight.

s: klI, (aBi + graha + BAve lyuw .) aBihAraH । ityamaraH ॥ cOryyakaraRaM । sammuKe haraRaM । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥ (sAhasaM । apacikIrzayA atikramyAkramaRaM .)
m: अभि-ग्रहण n. robbing, L.
a: अभिग्रहणं — Robbing, seizing in the presence of the owner.

s: tri, (aBi + gras + karmmaRi ktaH .) SatruRAkrAntaH । ityaBipannaSabdArTe amaraH ॥ (aBiyuktaH .)

अभि-गुम्फित mfn. strung together, interwoven, Śiś.

a: अभिगुप् — {c10c} P. 1 To guard, protect, defend; लंकायामाभिगुप्तायां सागरेण समंततः Rām. --2 To hide, conceal.

m: अभि-गुप्त mfn. guarded, protected.

strI aBi + gup--ktin । 1 aBirakzaRe “tadvrajamevetABigusyA AsAdayati” Sa॰ brA॰ ।
m: अभि-गुप्ति f. guarding, protecting, ŚBr. &c.
a: अभिगुप्तिः — f. Guarding, protecting.

m: अभि-√ गुर् (Subj. -जुगुरत्; Opt. 2. sg. -जुगुर्यास्) to assent, agree, approve of RV.
a: अभिगुर् — {c6c} U. To assent or agree to, approve of (Ved.)
